errors.evidence: The chart contains two lines (blue and purple) and one bar series (green), not three lines.
The value -32,203 corresponds to the year 2009, not 2008. The value for 2008 is -43,268.
The value for the green bars in 2020 is a positive value, 27,499. The value -81,484 corresponds to the year 2021.
The blue line begins at approximately 60,000 in 2005. The value 43,268 is not associated with this data point and appears to be hallucinated.
The value 51,275 belongs to the green bar data series for the year 2015. The blue line in 2014 is at approximately 105,000.
The value 39,552 belongs to the green bar data series for the year 2018. The blue line in 2018 is at a peak of approximately 175,000.
The blue line ends in 2024, not 2020. The value 27,499 belongs to the green bar data series for the year 2020.
The purple line begins at approximately 40,000 in 2005. The value 76,054 does not appear on the chart and is hallucinated.
The purple line's value in 2010 is approximately 65,000, which is not its peak. The peak occurs around 2020 at approximately 145,000. The value 144,923 is not explicitly shown on the chart.
The purple line in 2018 is at a peak of approximately 135,000. The value 118,575 is not associated with this data point and appears to be hallucinated.
The purple line ends in 2024, not 2022. Its value in 2022 is approximately 55,000, not 68,045.
